environment.description: Same application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 with a custom AppArmor profile 'express-webapp' loaded in enforce mode. The profile was generated via aa-genprof during a training run and then manually tightened. Profile grants read access to /opt/app/templates/** and /opt/app/public/**, write access ONLY to /opt/app/logs/**, and denies all other file write operations including /tmp/**. The profile includes a 'deny /tmp/** w,' rule and 'deny /tmp/** k,' (deny lock). Network access is allowed (inet stream). The cache directory configuration in the app still points to /tmp/express-cache but all write operations to that path will receive EACCES. Additionally, the profile includes 'deny capability dac_override,' preventing privilege escalation to bypass file permissions. The profile hash is verified at container start via aa-status.
